title_zh: Drexel 網上培訓：希望與靈性作為心理健康的基礎
title_en: Drexel Live Webinar: Hope and Spirituality as Foundations of Psychological Well-Being
summary_zh: 2026 年 11 月 10 日美東時間上午 9 時至 12:15，Drexel 舉辦網上培訓，由 Karin Gladney 博士主講。課程以 Snyder 希望理論與 Pargament 宗教靈性因應理論為本，探討希望、靈性與意義建構在精神健康與復元中的保護作用，並教授如何以合乎倫理及文化敏感的方式融入評估與介入。收費 27 美元，3 學分。
summary_en: Drexel University College of Medicine's live webinar on November 10, 2026 (9:00 a.m.-12:15 p.m. ET; 10:00 p.m.-1:15 a.m. Macau time), led by Karin C. Gladney, PhD, explores hope and spirituality as foundations of psychological well-being, drawing on Snyder's hope theory and Pargament's religious/spiritual coping framework. Cost is $27 for 3 CE credits (APA, NBCC and others).
caution: 港澳時間為 11 月 10 日 22:00 至 11 月 11 日 1:15；收費 27 美元，學分安排見原頁。
brief_zh: 收費 27 美元，3 學分（APA、NBCC 等）
講者 Karin C. Gladney 博士
內容包括希望理論、靈性因應及復元導向策略
supervision_questions: 希望與靈性在復元中的角色，你會如何在評估中自然地問起，而不把自己的信念加諸個案？

training.provider: Drexel University College of Medicine, Behavioral Healthcare Education

posts.title: Live Webinars: Behavioral Healthcare Education - Drexel University College of Medicine
posts.content: Drexel 大學醫學院行為健康教育的網上直播課程，本期探討希望、靈性與意義建構在精神健康與復元中的保護作用。

related.title_zh: PESI 免費兩日創傷培訓：Kate Truitt 談創傷神經科學與創傷後成長
related.title_en: PESI free 2-day clinical trauma training Kate Truitt neuroscience posttraumatic growth
related.summary_zh: 臨床心理學家 Kate Truitt 主講的 PESI 免費兩日線上培訓，2026 年 11 月 3–4 日美中時間上午 8 時至下午 4 時直播。內容涵蓋發展與依附創傷、PTSD 與複雜性創傷、解離、階段式治療。直播與三日重播免費，CE 學分與 CCTP 證書另收費。
related.summary_en: Clinical psychologist and applied neuroscientist Kate Truitt leads PESI's free two-day online trauma training on 3-4 November 2026 (8am-4pm US Central): developmental and attachment trauma, PTSD and complex trauma, dissociation and phase-based treatment. Live attendance and three-day replay are free; CE credit and the CCTP credential are available for a fee.

training.price: 免費（直播與重播免費；CE 學分與 CCTP 證書另收費）
training.ce_credits: 另收費（頁面原文：available for a fee）

related.title_zh: 免費網上研討會：用身體工具建立獲得性安全依附
related.title_en: Free Webinar: Creating Earned Secure Attachment with Somatic Tools
related.summary_zh: 這場免費線上工作坊教治療師用身體取向框架，幫助個案把安全依附變成身體經驗。課程不只談理論，會帶體驗式練習。適合處理發展性創傷與不安全依附的臨床工作者。
related.summary_en: Free one-hour virtual workshop (14 Oct 2026, 12–1pm ET) on helping clients move from insight to embodied secure attachment using three body-based techniques; 1 CE hour for several US licences.

training.provider: Phoenix Center for Experiential Trauma Therapy
training.ce_credits: 1 CE Hour for NBCC, PA SW, LPC, LMFT, and Psychologists

related.title_zh: Sue Johnson 親授伴侶 EFT 錄影課，每集 40 美元含 CE
related.title_en: Sue Johnson EFT webinar series on demand with CE
related.summary_zh: 美國 National Register of Health Service Psychologists 提供四集由 Sue Johnson 主講的情緒取向治療（Emotionally Focused Therapy，Sue Johnson 系，非 Greenberg 的 Emotion-Focused Therapy）錄影課，主題包括以依附為本的伴侶介入、EFT Tango 與微介入、Hold Me Tight 對話與依附創傷修復，以及創傷伴侶。每集 40 美元，含 1–1.5 小時 CE，課程等級標示為進階。
related.summary_en: The National Register of Health Service Psychologists offers four recorded webinars by Dr. Sue Johnson on Emotionally Focused Therapy (the Johnson model, not Greenberg's Emotion-Focused Therapy), covering attachment-based couple intervention, the EFT Tango, Hold Me Tight conversations and attachment injuries, and trauma couples. Each costs US$40 including 1–1.5 CE credits; instructional level is advanced.

training.provider: National Register of Health Service Psychologists
training.ce_credits: 第一集 1.5 小時、第二至四集各 1 小時（APA 認可主辦單位）
